LanguageData.ABY_ExperimentalSystemsDesc: Experimental systems are kept behind explicit switches. Disabling one stops its behavior and hides its Forge exposure without destroying installed equipment.
LanguageData.ABY_ModularTurrets_EnableDesc: Allows abyssal turret chassis to accept interchangeable weapon, auxiliary and passive systems. Disabling it makes the chassis inert while keeping installed parts intact.
LanguageData.ABY_ModularTurret_Subtitle: Install turret systems from the map. The main core fires; auxiliary and passive systems alter behavior.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretDisabledMessage: Modular turret systems are disabled in settings.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretEmpty_Main: Empty. The chassis will not fire until a main weapon core is installed.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretEmpty_Aux: Empty. Auxiliary modules add an independent timed support shot.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretEmpty_Passive: Empty. Passive modules alter range, main weapon cadence, or module power draw.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretOpenForgeHintTooltip: Turret system recipes are in Abyssal Forge → Turret Systems. Forge cards show whether a part is main, auxiliary, passive or a chassis.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretEditDisabled: Re-enable modular turrets in mod settings before editing installed modules.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretRemoveTooltip: Ejects the installed module as an item near the chassis. If no safe nearby cell exists, the module remains installed.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretNoAvailableModule: No compatible loose module is available on this map.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretNoModuleItem: The required loose module item could not be found.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretNoCompatibleDefs: No compatible systems exist for this slot.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretInstall_Incompatible: This module is not compatible with this chassis.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretInstall_NoMainSlot: This chassis has no main weapon slot.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretInstall_MainOccupied: The main weapon slot is already occupied.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretInstall_NoAuxSlot: This chassis has no auxiliary slot.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretInstall_AuxOccupied: The auxiliary slot is already occupied.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretInstall_PassiveDuplicate: This passive module is already installed.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretInstall_NoMap: The chassis must be spawned on a map before modules can be installed.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretRemove_NoMap: Cannot eject the module because the chassis is not spawned on a map.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretRemove_InvalidModule: Cannot eject an invalid module item.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretRemove_NoDropCell: Could not find a safe nearby cell for the ejected module. The module was kept installed.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModulePassiveStats: Range {0} · main cooldown {1} · power draw +{2} W
LanguageData.ABY_TurretChassisTooltipRole: Role: empty modular turret body. It cannot fire until a main weapon core is installed.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretChassisTooltipRuntime: Installed systems are stored inside the building and remain intact if the turret network is disabled.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretStatsPowerDraw: Power draw: {0} W base + {1} W modules = {2} W applied
LanguageData.ABY_TurretStatsKillSwitch: Safety switch: disables targeting, firing, placement and Forge exposure without removing installed systems.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretStatsTargeting: Targeting: ignores downed/dead targets and cancels burst if the target falls, leaves range, or loses line of sight.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretInspectDisabled: Modular turret systems are disabled in settings.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretInfo_ProfileDesc: The occupied slot and tactical role of this modular turret component.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretInfo_CompatibleChassisDesc: Chassis tags that can accept this module.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretInfo_EffectDesc: What this module does after installation.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretInfo_RangeDesc: Maximum firing range provided by this weapon module.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretInfo_CooldownDesc: Time before this module can fire again.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretInfo_BurstDesc: Number of projectiles fired per activation.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretInfo_BurstSpacingDesc: Delay between shots inside a burst.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretInfo_ProjectileDesc: The fired charge or bolt used by this weapon system.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretInfo_RangeOffsetDesc: Added to the installed main weapon range.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretInfo_CooldownMultiplierDesc: Multiplies the installed main weapon cooldown. Negative values are faster.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretInfo_CooldownOffsetDesc: Flat cooldown shift added after multiplier effects.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretInfo_MissRadiusOffsetDesc: Aiming correction reserved for later targeting refinement.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretInfo_ExtraPowerDrawDesc: Additional power consumed by the chassis while this module is installed and modular turrets are enabled.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretFilter_AllTooltip: Show all modular turret chassis and systems.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModuleEffect_ABY_TMD_RiftNeedl: Unleashes three rift needles in rapid succession, cutting down lightly armored enemies and pressing back dense swarms before they can close.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModuleEffect_ABY_TMD_PlasmaLan: Hurls a slower ultra-plasma lance with the reach and pressure needed to crack armor, elite targets and early boss shells.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModuleEffect_ABY_TMD_AshChoirR: Rakes the field with five ash-canticle shards, excellent for animals, light enemies and packed abyssal waves, but weak against heavy armor.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModuleEffect_ABY_TMD_ChoirArcE: Adds a timed canticle-wave strike that pulses through crowds while the turret’s main weapon keeps its own rhythm.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModuleEffect_ABY_TMD_CoolingLa: Bleeds excess heat through a bound lattice, tightening the firing cycle at the cost of higher power draw.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModuleEffect_ABY_TMD_Targeting: Extends the turret’s sighting geometry and steadies long-range tracking, demanding extra power to hold the sigil active.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModuleEffect_ABY_TMD_ResidueCa: Stores abyssal charge between shots, modestly extending reach and cadence while drawing more power from the grid.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModuleEffect_ABY_TMD_Sepulcher: Charges twin sepulcher rails before driving a single high-velocity penetrator into armored elites at extreme range.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModuleEffect_ABY_TMD_CinderMor: Throws an arcing cinder shell that bursts into hot ash and compact splash, strong against clustered enemies and static firing lines.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModuleEffect_ABY_TMD_NullArcDi: Releases a charged null-arc pulse that burns shields, stuns machines and chains through clustered elite support.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModuleEffect_ABY_TMD_AbyssalHa: Drives a heavy abyssal harpoon into breach targets, slowing their advance and dragging lesser bodies off their line.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModuleEffect_ABY_TMD_VesperLan: Projects a saint-clean lance with better reach and armor pressure than plasma while firing far faster than a sepulcher rail.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModuleEffect_ABY_TMD_RiftFlakB: Launches a compact rift seed that blooms into cutting shards around the impact point, punishing light swarms and clustered raiders.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModuleEffect_ABY_TMD_Sanctifie: Fires a charged prism bolt that cuts through a narrow lane, refracting judgment through enemies standing behind the first target.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModuleEffect_ABY_TMD_Crowncoil: Builds a six-lane crowncoil phase before pouring out an eighteen-shot gauss storm for sustained pressure against elites and heavy swarms.
LanguageData.ABY_TurretModuleEffect_ABY_TMD_Crownfire: Launches a vertical crownfire carrier that splits into guided micro-rockets over the target zone, saturating swarms and breach packs with sacred fire.
